description: Find connections between two places in Poland, including changes between trains and buses (PKS). from/to accept a station name ("Poznań Główny"), a town ("Zakopane" = all its stops) or coordinates "52.40,16.91". Returns several options with times, platforms, operators, changes and live delays (today).

arrive_by.description: If true, `time` is the latest arrival time instead of the earliest departure.

date.description: Date: "YYYY-MM-DD", "today", "tomorrow", a weekday ("friday", "piątek") or "DD.MM". Default: today.

max_transfers.description: Maximum number of changes (default 3, 0 = direct only).

modes.description: Restrict to these modes, e.g. ["train"] or ["train","bus"]. Default: all loaded.

time.description: Local time "HH:MM" (Europe/Warsaw). Default: now (today) or 04:00 (other days).

name: plan_journey
title: Plan a journey (train / bus)
